content_sections.text: Additional eligibility conditions include: The applicant must be a permanent resident of West Bengal. The applicant must have knowledge of local languages (should be able to read, write, and speak in Bengali).

rows.qualification_required: Graduate from any recognized university with at least 1-year Diploma course in Computer Application from a Govt. Registered Institution, working knowledge of MS Word, MS Excel, MS Power Point, MS Access and Internet, and minimum 3 years' experience in Government Sector or 5 years' experience in Private Sector in Data recording and Data analysis.

Completed GNM training course from an Institute recognized by the Indian Nursing Council / W.B. Nursing Council OR B.Sc. Nursing Course. Must be registered under W.B. Nursing Council with proficiency in local language.

content_sections.heading: DH&FWS Purba Bardhaman Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be made on the basis of marks obtained in academic qualification and computer test for Block Data Manager, and as per marks obtained in the qualifying examination for Staff Nurse. Block Data Manager Scoring Scale: Class X (5 marks), Class XII (10 marks), Graduation (15 marks), and Computer Test (70 marks). Qualifying marks for Computer Test is 50%. Staff Nurse Scoring Scale: As per marks obtained in the qualifying examination. Provisional Verification List: Published on 20 November 2026 on official websites.

faq.question: Q1. What is DH&FWS Purba Bardhaman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: DH&FWS Purba Bardhaman Recruitment 2026 is an official recruitment notification for hiring 27 contractual vacancies for Block Data Manager and Staff Nurse posts under the XV-Finance Commission.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: A total of 27 vacancies are available, comprising 6 for Block Data Manager and 21 for Staff Nurse.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to fill up the online application is 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Block Data Manager?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Graduates from a recognized university with at least a 1-year Diploma course in Computer Application from a Govt. Registered Institution, working knowledge of MS Office and Internet, and minimum 3 years' experience in Government Sector or 5 years' experience in Private Sector in data recording and analysis.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Staff Nurse?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed a GNM training course from an Institute recognized by the Indian Nursing Council / W.B. Nursing Council or B.Sc. Nursing Course, and must be registered under W.B. Nursing Council with proficiency in the local language.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is minimum 21 years and maximum 40 years for Block Data Manager, and upper age limit is 40 years for Staff Nurse as on the specified cut-off date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 100/- for General candidates and Rs. 50/- for reserved categories, payable via NEFT.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly pay is Rs. 22,000/- for Block Data Manager and Rs. 25,000/- for Staff Nurse.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: These posts are purely contractual in nature with an initial engagement period up to March 2027, renewable based on performance and authority approval.

faq.question: Q10. When will the provisional list for verification be published?
faq.answer: The provisional list for original testimonial verification will be published on 20 November 2026 on www.purbabardhaman.nic.in and www.wbhealth.gov.in.
